purpose: Pre-run housekeeping for the OE-1 dev pilot, per results/stage2_openended/PILOT_SPEC.md sections 3-4. No pilot runs, no API calls.

torch_build.note: macOS arm64 wheel: CPU-only build, no CUDA. MPS backend is present but all OE-1 scoring pins device='cpu'.

test_pair.a: I think the government moved far too slowly on this, and people paid for that delay.
test_pair.b: They were much too slow to act, and ordinary people bore the cost of that hesitation.
test_pair.note: One fixed pair, identical across all four models, so the cosines below are same-input comparisons. Same position, different words.

models.name: intfloat/e5-large-v2
models.prefixes_used: query: / passage: (required by e5; applied as 'query: ' on text a and 'passage: ' on text b)

models_note: load_seconds for the first three includes first-time download from HF; MiniLM was already in the local cache. encode_seconds is model-in-memory encode of the 2-sentence pair on CPU, torch threads=4. Absolute cosines are NOT comparable across models (each has its own similarity scale, e5 most compressed toward the high end), so the section 3 selection rule must compare own-minus-imposter separation, never raw cosine level.

provider_disagreement.resolution: Recorded the Google AI Studio row because that is the endpoint doppler calls (src/doppler/gemini.py wraps the google-genai AI Studio SDK). Routing elsewhere costs 2x and must be repriced.

judge_vs_robustness_note: Literal strings 'gemini-3.5-flash' and 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' are different model versions in the same family, satisfying C2.3's different-version clause. Family overlap is already declared in C3.

costlog_edit.change: Added MODEL_PRICES['gemini-3.5-flash'] = {'in': 0.75, 'out': 4.50} with source comment. The gemini-3.5-flash-lite entry and the PRICE_IN/PRICE_OUT constants are untouched.

judge_cost_check.assumption: 170 judge calls at the spec's section 6 volumes (850 tokens in, 40 out per call)
judge_cost_check.verdict: inside the pre-registered band; the spec's 'up to 3x flash-lite' placeholder holds at AI Studio prices (2.5x in, 1.8x out)
